visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Studio setting: A man with glasses wearing a white button-down shirt sits at a table covered with a green checkered tablecloth. He gestures widely with his hands, displaying high facial energy and clear articulation while looking directly at the lens. Behind him is a wooden shelving unit containing books and decorative items under warm indoor lighting. (2) Close-up: A hand holds a brown glass bottle to someone's mouth, capturing the action of drinking. (3) Night exterior: A black car is shown skidding on a snow-covered road. Its headlights cut through the dark, illuminating falling snow and the icy ground as the vehicle loses traction. (4) Studio: The presenter returns, pointing his finger toward the camera for emphasis. (5) Cartoon segment: A clip from an animation shows Bugs Bunny in blue pajamas and a nightcap sleeping in a bed. (6) Cartoon segment: A clip of Bart Simpson looking extremely tired with bloodshot, sagging eyes. (7) CCTV footage: Inside a dimly lit bar, a man in a dark t-shirt sits on a high stool. He suddenly loses his balance and falls backward off the stool onto the floor. (8) Studio: The presenter gestures with both hands in front of him, explaining a concept. (9) Outdoor garden: A man in a pink shirt and white suit jacket walks near a fence while talking on a blue smartphone. He stumbles over his own feet and falls onto the green lawn. (10) Close-up: A Doberman Pinscher's face fills the frame as it performs a wide, dramatic yawn, showing its teeth. (11) Sci-fi clip: A close-up of the character Spock from Star Trek looking intently toward the side. (12) Technical diagram: A still image showing a man's face with red and blue tracking dots on the lips, accompanied by the text 'MAR' and a mathematical formula for Mouth Aspect Ratio. (13) Technical diagram: A similar face image with dots around the eyes, labeled 'EAR' for Eye Aspect Ratio, illustrating vertical and horizontal distance measurements. (14) Close-up: A white cat yawns widely towards the camera, showing a pink tongue and sharp teeth. (15) Digital interface: A technical display of a face grid labeled 'DMS (Driver Monitoring System)' featuring 'embedding values' and HOG image comparisons. (16) Aerial shot: A high-angle view of a parking lot filled with numerous large white and green public buses. (17) Urban street: Pedestrians are seen crossing a road at night, with traffic lights and city buildings in the background. (18) Studio: The presenter points downward with both hands toward the bottom of the frame.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 那些我們可能都搞錯的交通科學. (2) [Variety]: No.4. (3) [Subtitle]: 不喝酒就不會酒駕? (4) [Subtitle]: 開車不喝酒, 是因為酒精會搞亂你的腦. (5) [Slogan]: 但美國國家職業安全及健康研究院警告. (6) [Subtitle]: 如果你清醒17小時沒睡, 你頭昏目眩反應遲鈍的程度, 就跟血液酒精濃度0.05%的醉漢一模一樣. (7) [Subtitle]: 如果24小時沒睡, 等效血液酒精濃度0.1%. (8) [Variety]: 要知道. (9) [Subtitle]: 血液中酒精濃度達0.03%以上就算酒駕了. (10) [Subtitle]: 也就是說很多人以為自己只是有點累. (11) [Subtitle]: 但你的疲累大腦就是醉了. (12) [Subtitle]: 要是還在路上開車, 形同犯罪. (13) [Slogan]: OK 熬夜別開車, 開車不硬撐. (14) [Subtitle]: 但有沒有喝酒一吹就知道, 自己累不累判斷力還夠不夠要怎麼知道呢? (15) [Slogan]: 波蘭弗羅茨瓦夫工業大學的團隊想了個辦法. (16) [Subtitle]: 在駕駛旁邊裝了個監視器. (17) [Subtitle]: 波蘭團隊不用人力, 而是使用了影像辨識, 自動化監測駕駛的嘴跟眼. (18) [Logo]: PS. (19) [Variety]: 嘴部長寬比 MAR. (20) [Variety]: 專門抓駕駛打哈欠. (21) [Subtitle]: 數值是將內唇兩點之間的距離, 跟外唇兩點之間的距離相加, 然後將總和除以嘴角之間的距離乘以2. (22) [Variety]: 眼睛長寬比 EAR. (23) [Subtitle]: 則是用眼眶特徵點的垂直距離, 除以水平距離估算眼睛開闔. (24) [Subtitle]: 一般當數值低於0.19時, 代表一個人已經閉上了眼睛. (25) [Subtitle]: 持續眨眼和頻繁打哈欠, 就代表駕駛已處於疲勞狀態. (26) [Subtitle]: 因此系統會連續檢查120秒. (27) [Variety]: 這就是駕駛員監測系統 DMS (Driver Monitoring System). (28) [Slogan]: Source: synergytek. (29) [Subtitle]: 但只靠DMS還不夠. (30) [Subtitle]: 尤其是是有大批司機的客運公司. (31) [Subtitle]: 也為了全體行人與用路人的安全. (32) [Subtitle]: 這需要什麼科技呢? 快點這裡來看看吧!

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate viewers on the severe dangers of fatigued driving, equating its effects to drunk driving, and subsequently introduces the DMS technology based on MAR and EAR metrics as a viable monitoring solution.
